meta.title: 出门旅行，会不会用长焦的区别原来这么大
meta.title_en: Travel Photography: Telephoto Makes All the Difference

scenes.context: 跟纪念碑合影想连背景一起拍大，别急着往前站，先请摄影师一直往后退。
sentences: First have the photographer step back.
paraphrase: First have the photographer step back.
scenes.speak: You want the background bigger. First have the photographer step back.

scenes.context: 一直退退退到十米开外，放心大胆地退，退得越多背景越大。
sentences: The farther back, the bigger the background.
paraphrase: The farther back, the bigger the background.
scenes.speak: Back up past ten meters. The farther back, the bigger the background.

scenes.context: 退好之后再切到手机或相机的长焦焦段，比如六倍变焦，人物大小不变但背景被拉近放大。
sentences: Now switch to the telephoto setting.
Six-times zoom pulls the background in.
paraphrase: Now switch to the telephoto setting.
Six-times zoom pulls the background in.
scenes.speak: Now switch to the telephoto setting. Six-times zoom pulls the background in.

scenes.context: 切完长焦后沿着平行方向缓慢运镜，让画面有一种航拍一样的推进感。
sentences: Pan slowly along the parallel line.
Movement adds life to the frame.
paraphrase: Pan slowly along the parallel line.
Movement adds life to the frame.
scenes.speak: Pan slowly along the parallel line. Movement adds life to the frame.

scenes.context: 同场景双屏对照：长焦压缩背景，广角拉开空间，湖面占比明显放大。
scenes.speak: Telephoto compresses the background. Wide angle expands the space.

scenes.context: 远距离加长焦让背景看起来更近更大，人和背景的比例一下拉开，照片更有层次。
scenes.speak: Telephoto brings the background closer. The ratio shift adds depth.

scenes.context: 切长焦后背景更大、更壮观，这就是出门旅行用长焦的区别。
scenes.speak: Telephoto makes the backdrop spectacular. That's the telephoto difference.

scenes.context: 这个旅拍小技巧你学会了吗？下次出去旅行拍照就试试。
sentences: Did you pick up this trick?
Try it on your next trip.
paraphrase: Did you pick up this trick?
Try it on your next trip.
scenes.speak: Did you pick up this trick? Try it on your next trip.

practice: Now switch to the telephoto setting.
pitfalls: 长焦保持人物大小放大背景
